name: Jared Burrows' talks
description: Read-only agent over Jared Burrows' conference talks. Send it a message and it replies with the talks, newest first, or with one talk in full when the message names a talk id. It answers every message directly: no tasks, no streaming, no push notifications, and no authentication.

skills.name: List talks
skills.description: Lists Jared Burrows' conference talks, newest first, with each talk's id, date, title, venue, location and links. A message naming a year, or a data part {"year": 2017}, lists only that year's talks.
examples: What conference talks has Jared Burrows given?
Which talks did he give in 2017?

skills.name: Get talk
skills.description: Returns one talk in full, including its abstract, when the message contains a talk id from list-talks or a data part {"id": "..."}.
